label: Implementation pair
definition: Applies only to named implementation endpoints.

label: Lineage pair
definition: Applies to the source-local lineage endpoints.

label: Lineage-segment pair
definition: Applies to specific P3 lineage segments.

label: Variant pair
definition: Applies at family-variant level.

label: Family wide
definition: Applies to the entire candidate or canonical family.

label: Value portability only
definition: Does not block family identity, only measurement transformation.

label: Historical interval
definition: Applies only during a governed period.

label: Source specific
definition: Applies only within or against a named source.

label: Block same proposition
definition: Members cannot share one proposition-defined family.

label: Block same variant
definition: Members may share a family only in distinct variants.

label: Block value portability
definition: Family relation may stand, but response values cannot be harmonized.

label: Parent-child only
definition: Members may be linked hierarchically but not merged.

label: Block derived/direct merge
definition: Derived index and direct item remain separate.

label: Block behavior/disposition merge
definition: Actual behavior and willingness/intention remain separate.

label: Block target collapse
definition: Distinct social targets remain separate.

label: Block operator collapse
definition: Distinct operators remain separate.

label: Block timeframe collapse
definition: Meaningful temporal scopes remain separate.

label: Block population scope collapse
definition: Distinct reference populations remain separate.

label: Block geographic scope collapse
definition: Distinct geographic scopes remain separate.

label: Block polarity collapse
definition: Positive, negative, exclusionary, or reverse forms cannot be silently merged.

label: Block source-structure inference
definition: Battery label or position cannot manufacture proposition identity.

label: Block heterogeneous lineage
definition: A materially drifting lineage cannot enter cleanly without segmentation.

label: Insufficient evidence
definition: Required authoritative fields are unrecovered or conflicting.

label: Redirect semantic artifact
definition: Inherited semantic placement is contaminated.

label: Direct question text
definition: Exact source-native question text.

label: Parent prompt
definition: Battery or matrix parent supplying operator, target, or condition.

label: Response dictionary
definition: Labels or coding that establish topology and direction.

label: Source structure
definition: Adjudicated battery or source structure.

label: Lineage history
definition: Source-local continuity and implementation drift evidence.

label: P2 ruling
definition: Closed cross-source authority ruling.

label: Semantic overlay
definition: Corrected diagnostic coordinate; never sufficient alone.

label: Codebook
definition: Authoritative source documentation.

label: Row-authority master
definition: Governing row-level evidence.

label: Manual adjudication
definition: Structured human decision bound to evidence.

label: Discovered
definition: Candidate generated mechanically and not yet evidence-complete.

label: Generated candidate
definition: Candidate membership and diagnostics materialized.

label: Evidence complete
definition: Required evidence surfaces are present.

label: Adjudication required
definition: Candidate awaits structured human authority.

label: Clean candidate
definition: Coherent proposition with no internal family blocker.

label: Response-variant candidate
definition: One proposition with governed response variants.

label: Split required
definition: Connected component contains multiple propositions.

label: Hierarchical relation only
definition: Related families must remain separate and linked hierarchically.

label: Collision bearing
definition: Internal hard or unresolved constraints prevent clean admission.

label: Structural analogy only
definition: Structure correspondence lacks proposition authority.

label: Insufficient authority
definition: Evidence cannot establish family identity.

label: Rejected semantic artifact
definition: Candidate was produced by contaminated semantic placement.

label: Accepted canonical
definition: Canonical family authorized without variants.

label: Accepted with variants
definition: Canonical family authorized with explicit variants.

label: Blocked unresolved
definition: Authority remains fail-closed pending evidence.

label: Rejected
definition: Proposed family is semantically invalid.

label: Superseded
definition: Replaced by later split, merge, or revision authority.

label: Deprecated
definition: Historically valid but prohibited for new builds.

label: Known
definition: Field value is directly recoverable from authoritative source evidence.

label: Explicitly unspecified
definition: The item genuinely leaves this dimension unspecified; this is not missing documentation.

label: Not applicable
definition: The field does not apply to this proposition.

label: Unrecovered
definition: The field may exist but authoritative evidence is absent or truncated.

label: Heterogeneous
definition: Implementations inside the lineage carry materially different values.

label: Conflicting
definition: Authoritative sources disagree and the conflict is unresolved.

label: Diagnostic only
definition: A value exists only in inherited or heuristic diagnostics and cannot authorize membership.

label: Battery hyperedge
definition: Parent prompt and child proposition families.

label: Cross-source battery analogy
definition: Adjudicated analogous batteries across sources.

label: Derived-index constitution
definition: Derived index and constituent items.

label: Sibling-family construct
definition: Separate proposition families within a broader construct.

label: Target hierarchy
definition: Broader and narrower target families.

label: Response-contract class
definition: Shared response architecture without proposition identity.

label: Actual past behavior
definition: Action already performed in a specified or implied past period.

label: Actual current behavior
definition: Current or habitual action.

label: Willingness or disposition
definition: Readiness to act without a claim of actual behavior.

label: Intended future behavior
definition: Planned future action.

label: Current state
definition: Present condition or status.

label: Past state
definition: Historical condition or status.

label: Future expectation
definition: Anticipated future condition.

label: Normative principle
definition: What should be, independent of current performance.

label: Performance evaluation
definition: Assessment of how an actor or system performs.

label: Subjective affect
definition: Happiness, satisfaction, fear, anger, or related affect.

label: Frequency measure
definition: How often something occurs.

label: Rank or priority
definition: Ordering among alternatives.

label: Direct proposition
definition: A direct survey proposition.

label: Derived construct
definition: A calculated or composite construct.

label: Unspecified
definition: Modality is explicitly absent.

label: Implementation
definition: Specific source-wave-variable evidence atom.

label: Source-local lineage
definition: P2-governed longitudinal continuity unit.

label: P3 lineage segment
definition: Family-authority segment of a materially heterogeneous lineage.

label: Candidate component
definition: Mechanically generated connected component.

label: Candidate family
definition: Provisional proposition grouping.

label: Canonical family
definition: Adjudicated proposition family.

label: Family variant
definition: Governed variation preserving the proposition.

label: Hyperedge
definition: N-ary semantic or measurement structure.

label: Authority release
definition: Versioned immutable authority publication.

label: Trust
definition: Confidence, trust, or reliance directed toward a target.

label: Satisfaction
definition: Evaluation of satisfaction with a condition, institution, or outcome.

label: Approval
definition: Approval or disapproval of an actor, action, or system.

label: Support
definition: Normative or practical support for a proposition, institution, or regime.

label: Preference
definition: Choice or preference between alternatives.

label: Evaluation
definition: Assessment of quality, condition, performance, fairness, or adequacy.

label: Belief
definition: Belief, judgment, attribution, or proposition acceptance.

label: Expectation
definition: Anticipation of a future condition or outcome.

label: Fear or concern
definition: Fear, worry, concern, or perceived threat.

label: Behavior
definition: Reported past or current action.

label: Willingness
definition: Disposition or willingness to act.

label: Intention
definition: Stated plan or intention to act.

label: Frequency
definition: How often an action or condition occurs.

label: Access
definition: Availability or ability to obtain a resource or service.

label: Experience
definition: Reported experience of an event or condition.

label: Importance
definition: Importance assigned to a value, outcome, or quality.

label: Priority
definition: Ranking or priority among competing options.

label: Identification
definition: Self-identification, affiliation, or categorical identity.

label: Membership
definition: Formal or informal membership in a group.

label: Knowledge
definition: Knowledge or awareness of a fact or institution.

label: Derived score
definition: A computed index or score rather than a direct question.

label: Unspecified
definition: The governing operator is explicitly absent.

label: Proposition plus response identity
definition: Same question proposition and response topology compatible at the recorded ceiling.

label: Proposition identity only
definition: Same question proposition; response topology or value portability differs or remains unproven.

label: Nested target relation
definition: Broader/narrower or role-specific target relation.

label: Construct coordinate
definition: Shared conceptual domain without proposition identity.

label: Structure-member analogy
definition: Correspondence supported by adjudicated battery or structure relations.

label: Explicit negative
definition: A recorded operation or grain is prohibited.

label: Redirect
definition: The inherited neighborhood is wrong or the pair belongs elsewhere.

label: Unresolved
definition: Evidence is insufficient; no positive authority may be inferred.

label: Question and response topology
definition: Proposition identity plus compatible response architecture.

label: Question proposition only
definition: Proposition identity without value or topology portability.

label: Domain coordinate only
definition: Shared domain; no family connectivity.

label: Construct-target coordinate only
definition: Shared construct and target; operator or proposition differs.

label: Hierarchical only
definition: Broader/narrower relation only.

label: No positive authority
definition: Negative, redirect, or unresolved.

label: Binary
definition: Two substantive response categories.

label: Nominal
definition: Unordered categories.

label: Ordinal
definition: Ordered categories without guaranteed equal intervals.

label: Likert
definition: Agreement or evaluation scale.

label: Frequency ordinal
definition: Ordered frequency categories.

label: Open numeric
definition: Open numeric response.

label: Ranking
definition: Rank order among options.

label: Forced choice
definition: Choice between competing alternatives.

label: Multiselect
definition: Multiple selections permitted.

label: Open text
definition: Open-ended textual response.

label: Derived index
definition: Calculated multi-item or transformed index.

label: Administrative
definition: Identifier, weight, routing, or non-substantive field.

label: Unknown
definition: Response topology unrecovered.

label: Respondent
definition: The individual survey respondent.

label: Household
definition: The respondent's household or family unit.

label: Parent or guardian
definition: A parent, guardian, or older generation.

label: Child or descendant
definition: A child, dependent, or later generation.

label: Government
definition: A government or governing administration.

label: Institution
definition: An institutional actor or organization.

label: Social group
definition: A named or implied social collectivity.

label: Country or population
definition: A country, national population, or named polity.

label: Derived system
definition: A calculated or composite subject.

label: Unspecified
definition: No subject role is specified.
